basic_details.job_title: BSI Staff Car Driver Recruitment 2027 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Botanical Survey of India (BSI), under the Ministry of Environment, Forest & Climate Change, Government of India, will fill 06 posts of Staff Car Driver (Ordinary Grade) on deputation/ absorption basis, or on deputation/ re-employment basis for Armed Forces Personnel. Regular MTS and regular Group-C Level-1 employees of other Central Government Ministries or Departments may apply in the Annexure-I proforma through proper channel to the Director, Botanical Survey of India, Kolkata. Applications must reach within 60 (sixty) days from the publication of the advertisement in Employment News/ Rozga

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: Within 60 days from publication – about 20 January 2027 (60 days from 21 November 2026)

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation or absorption shall be not exceeding 56 (fifty six) years as on the closing date of receipt of applications.

qualification.details: Deputation or Absorption: officials holding the post of MTS (Multi Tasking Staff) on regular basis, or regular Group-C employees in Level-1 of the pay matrix (Rs. 18000-56900), in other Ministries or Departments of the Central Government who fulfil the qualifications below. Armed Forces Personnel: those due to retire or to be transferred to reserve within a period of one year, with the requisite experience and qualifications, shall also be considered. The experience qualification is relaxable at the discretion of the competent authority for Scheduled Castes or Scheduled Tribes candidates, if at any stage of selection the competent authority is of the opinion that sufficient candidates with the requisite experience are not likely to be available to fill the vacancy reserved for them. | The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation or absorption shall be not exceeding 56 (fifty six) years as on the closing date of receipt of applications. | Pay Scale: Level 2 in the pay matrix (Rs. 19900-63200/-). The pay of the selected officer will be regulated in accordance with DoPT's O.M. No. 6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay-II) dated 17.06.2010 as amended from time to time. selection_process: As stated in the Annexure-I declaration
the information in the Curriculum Vitae
supported by the documents on essential qualification and work experience
will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection.
important_instructions: Candidates who apply will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently. Applications received without the listed documents or after the prescribed date shall not be considered. The forwarding office must ensure that the particulars of the candidates are verified. Through Annexure-II, the employer certifies that the applicant, if selected, will be relieved immediately, and states whether cadre clearance has been granted by the competent authority. Annexure-I includes a column for employees of organisations not following Central Government pay-scales, who may enclose the latest salary slip showing basic pay, allowances and total emoluments.

content_sections.heading: BSI Staff Car Driver (Ordinary Grade) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Botanical Survey of India, Ministry of Environment, Forest & Climate Change
Staff Car Driver (Ordinary Grade) – General Central Service, Group 'C', Non-Gazetted, Non-Ministerial
Pass in 10th standard, valid driving license for motor cars, 3 years' driving experience
Not exceeding 56 (fifty six) years as on the closing date of receipt of applications
Deputation or Absorption; for Armed Forces Personnel: Deputation or Re-employment
Gangtok, Dehradun, Jodhpur, Pune, Shillong and Port Blair (one post each)
Within 60 days from publication in Employment News (about 20 January 2027 )

content_sections.heading: About BSI
content_sections.text: Botanical Survey of India is an office of the Government of India under the Ministry of Environment, Forest & Climate Change, with its office at CGO Complex, 3rd MSO Building, Salt Lake, Kolkata. The six driver posts are in BSI's regional units at Gangtok (SHRC), Dehradun (NRC), Jodhpur (AZRC), Pune (WRC), Shillong (ERC) and Port Blair (ANRC). The vacancy circular was issued by Ranajit Kumar Roy, Sr. Administrative Officer & Head of Office, on 20 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be made in the enclosed Bio-data/Curriculum Vitae Proforma (Annexure-I) and forwarded through proper channel, that is, through the applicant's present employer, to this address: The Director, Botanical Survey of India, CGO Complex, 3rd MSO Building, Block-F, 5th & 6th Floor, DF Block, Sector I, Salt Lake City, Kolkata-700064 The notice does not mention what to write on the envelope or a specific postal mode such as speed post.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Deputation or Absorption: officials holding the post of MTS (Multi Tasking Staff) on regular basis, or regular Group-C employees in Level-1 of the pay matrix (Rs. 18000-56900), in other Ministries or Departments of the Central Government who fulfil the qualifications below. Armed Forces Personnel: those due to retire or to be transferred to reserve within a period of one year, with the requisite experience and qualifications, shall also be considered. They would be given deputation terms up to the date on which they are due for release from the Armed Forces; thereafter they may be continued on re-employment. Possession of a valid driving license for motor cars. Knowledge of motor mechanism (the candidate should be able to remove minor defects in vehicle). Experience of driving a motor car for at least 3 (three) years. Pass in 10th standard. 3 (three) years service as Home Guard or Civil Volunteers. Qualifications are relaxable at the discretion of the Competent Authority in the case of candidates otherwise well qualified. The experience qualification is relaxable at the discretion of the competent authority for Scheduled Castes or Scheduled Tribes candidates, if at any stage of selection the competent authority is of the opinion that sufficient candidates with the requisite experience are not likely to be available to fill the vacancy reserved for them. The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation or absorption shall be not exceeding 56 (fifty six) years as on the closing date of receipt of applications. Pay Scale: Level 2 in the pay matrix (Rs. 19900-63200/-). The pay of the selected officer will be regulated in accordance with DoPT's O.M. No. 6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay-II) dated 17.06.2010 as amended from time to time. The period of deputation, including the period of deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately preceding this appointment in the same or some other organisation or Department of the Central Government, shall ordinarily not exceed three years. For full eligibility conditions, candidates should refer to the official vacancy circular.

content_sections.heading: BSI Staff Car Driver (Ordinary Grade) Job Description
content_sections.text: Driving of station vehicle/ wagons for collection of flora and for carrying heavy equipments like herbarium, pressed, vasculums, drawing papers, chemicals, glassware etc. Petty wayside repairs of the vehicles.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Proof of educational qualifications and experience (self-attested). Original/ attested photocopies of the APARs for the last 5 years (Annexure-II asks for the original APARs or a clean photocopy of the APAR dossier attested on each page by an officer not lower than Under Secretary to the Govt. of India). Vigilance clearance certificate. Integrity Certificate. No Major/ Minor penalty certificate for last 10 years (the employer may alternatively enclose a penalty statement for the last 10 years). Annexure-II, filled and certified by the present employer, with signature, name, designation and telephone number of the forwarding officer and office stamp.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: As stated in the Annexure-I declaration, the information in the Curriculum Vitae, supported by the documents on essential qualification and work experience, will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BSI Staff Car Driver Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 06 posts of Staff Car Driver (Ordinary Grade), one each at Gangtok, Dehradun, Jodhpur, Pune, Shillong and Port Blair.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach within 60 days from the publication of the advertisement in Employment News dated 21-27 November 2026, which is about 20 January 2027 (60 days from 21 November 2026).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for BSI Staff Car Driver (Ordinary Grade)?
faq.answer: Pass in 10th standard, a valid driving license for motor cars, knowledge of motor mechanism and at least 3 years of experience of driving a motor car.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age for appointment by deputation or absorption is not exceeding 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a BSI Staff Car Driver?
faq.answer: The post is in Level 2 of the pay matrix (Rs. 19900-63200/-), and the pay of the selected officer is regulated under DoPT's O.M. dated 17.06.2010.

faq.question: Q6. Who can apply for this deputation post?
faq.answer: Regular MTS or regular Group-C Level-1 (Rs. 18000-56900) employees of other Central Government Ministries or Departments, and Armed Forces Personnel due to retire or be transferred to reserve within one year.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for BSI Staff Car Driver Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill Annexure-I, get Annexure-II certified by your present employer, attach the listed documents and forward the application through proper channel to The Director, Botanical Survey of India, Salt Lake City, Kolkata-700064.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the deputation period?
faq.answer: The period of deputation, including any immediately preceding ex-cadre deputation, shall ordinarily not exceed three years.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: The Selection Committee will assess the information in the Curriculum Vitae and the supporting documents on essential qualification and work experience.

faq.question: Q10. Can I withdraw my application after applying?
faq.answer: No. Candidates who apply will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently.
